answer: Mirror Bond Vault: every agent locks 900 POA into the Mirror vault and receives a numbered Sonnet receipt, a signed bond certificate tied to one verified device key, before it can earn. The vault holds the bond for 30 epochs and publishes each Sonnet receipt on a public mirror ledger, so any duplicate device key is visible instantly and both bonds are slashed. Building 5,000 fake identities costs 4,500,000 POA locked plus 5,000 device keys, while one honest agent risks a single refundable 900 POA bond.
